commit_message: fix(firewall): keep inactive UFW dry-run noninteractive

replacements.old:
runner(
            [ufw, "--dry-run", "reload"]
            if was_active
            else [ufw, "--dry-run", "enable"],
            check=True,
            timeout=30,
        )
replacements.new:
runner(
            [ufw, "--dry-run", "reload"]
            if was_active
            else [ufw, "--force", "--dry-run", "enable"],
            check=True,
            timeout=30,
        )

replacements.old:
self.assertTrue(any(
                call[-2:] == ["--force", "enable"] for call in calls
            ))
            self.assertTrue(any(call[-1] == "disable" for call in calls))
replacements.new:
self.assertTrue(any(
                call[-4:] == ["/usr/bin/ufw", "--force", "--dry-run", "enable"]
                for call in calls
            ))
            self.assertTrue(any(
                call[-2:] == ["--force", "enable"] for call in calls
            ))
            self.assertTrue(any(call[-1] == "disable" for call in calls))

replacements.old:
## v2.10.3

- FIX Firewall Manager 0.5.2: IPv6 standard/trusted-source pravidla se v `/etc/ufw/before6.rules` generují do skutečných UFW řetězců `ufw6-before-input/output/forward`, ne chybně do IPv4 `ufw-before-*`. Fyzický VM test 0.5.1 chybu odhalil při Apply jako `ip6tables-restore: No chain/target/match by that name`.
replacements.new:
## v2.10.3

- FIX Firewall Manager 0.5.2: dry-run pro aktivaci neaktivního UFW používá `--force`, aby `ufw --dry-run enable` nikdy nečekalo na interaktivní potvrzení a guarded Apply zůstal plně neinteraktivní až do vlastního potvrzovacího kroku SysApps.
- FIX Firewall Manager 0.5.2: IPv6 standard/trusted-source pravidla se v `/etc/ufw/before6.rules` generují do skutečných UFW řetězců `ufw6-before-input/output/forward`, ne chybně do IPv4 `ufw-before-*`. Fyzický VM test 0.5.1 chybu odhalil při Apply jako `ip6tables-restore: No chain/target/match by that name`.

replacements.old: - Manual Apply must preserve unrelated UFW lines, stage/validate deterministic candidates, back up every touched file, arm an independent time-limited rollback before live activation, run UFW dry-run validation, apply atomically, require live management acknowledgement and verify candidate hashes before committing local apply state.
replacements.new: - Manual Apply must preserve unrelated UFW lines, stage/validate deterministic candidates, back up every touched file, arm an independent time-limited rollback before live activation, run UFW dry-run validation, apply atomically, require live management acknowledgement and verify candidate hashes before committing local apply state. Dry-run activation of an inactive UFW must use `--force` so the preflight itself never waits for UFW interactive confirmation.
